## Purpose
Implements `ClarifyEngine`, the Human_Gate that runs the clarification round(s) of a pipeline: generates a questionnaire (via LLM or a static fallback), emits it to the client, pauses until the user answers (or skips), merges the answers into the planning context, and resumes the pipeline.

## Shape
- `ClarifyEngine.run(...)` — the entry point; drives the pause/resume/replay flow across up to `max_rounds` rounds (hard-capped at `MAX_CLARIFICATION_ROUNDS = 3`), supports `replay_questions`/`replay_round` to re-arm a restart-parked gate with the exact previously-asked questions instead of re-generating them.
- `_generate_questions_via_llm(...)` — builds a Spec-Kit-style, content-aware questionnaire from the planning context (brief, coverage map, already-clarified topics, pipeline-specific guidance), asking the LLM for targeted questions with recommended answers.
- `_generate_questions(...)` — orchestrates the LLM path with a fallback; `_classify_ambiguity` buckets a missing-information item into one of 11 taxonomy categories via keyword matching when no richer classification is available.
- `_parse_llm_json_array(raw)` — tolerantly extracts and repairs a JSON array from LLM output (stripping markdown fences, fixing smart quotes/trailing commas/missing separators) using only `json.loads`, never `eval`, returning `None` on unrecoverable input so the caller falls back to the static question library.
- `_persist_qa(...)` / `_merge_answers(...)` — persist the round's Q&A and fold answers back into the planning context.

## Why this shape
The module docstring frames this as a Phase-2 "full pause/resume implementation" with two operating modes (brief-grounded vs spec-grounded, depending on whether a Specify_Agent has already produced a `spec` artifact); `_parse_llm_json_array`'s repair heuristics exist because the docstring notes the target model (Haiku 4.5) frequently returns slightly-malformed JSON, and the function is deliberately conservative (`json.loads` only, never `eval`/`exec`) so a malformed LLM response degrades to the static fallback instead of crashing or executing untrusted text.
